newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Vivid Tech.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts Vivid Tech.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it initiated coverage of bomb detection stock Vivid Technologies Inc with a buy rating and a 12-month price target of $18 to $20.
-- The brokerage said it expected revenues to increase 80 percent in fiscal 1997 and at a 30 percent rate over the next three years.

-- Lehman noted the stock trades in line with its peers, despite having a "commanding" 75 percent market share in world airport installations. It maintained Vivid had not lost a single head-to-head competitive bidding process to rivals.
